One calm, dense, data-first look for every TKC screen.

Tokens are CSS custom properties (--tkc-*) that feed both the Angular shell theme and the legacy Dawn override. Everything on this page uses them. Change the brand hue above: the whole palette, all contrast ratios and every component follow from that one token (--tkc-brand-hue).

Angular = shell themeLegacy = Dawn override[custom] = needs Angular work

Colour Primitives hold the palette. Semantic tokens give it meaning. Components only use semantic tokens.

Proposal: one brand hueTKC has no brand palette yet. The brand colour is "harbour teal" (hue 195). It lives in one token, --tkc-brand-hue. The brand ramp, the neutrals (tinted with the brand hue), the navbar and focus ring all derive from it. Status colours (green, amber, red, blue, violet) keep fixed hues so meaning never changes with branding. Contrast was checked at hue 195; re-check after a hue swap (the ratios below recalculate live).

Primitive ramps

Semantic tokens: light and dark

Each row shows the token in both modes, side by side, and the token's CSS name. Hex values are at the default hue.

Contrast checks

WCAG 2.2 AA: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for UI boundaries and focus indicators (1.4.11, 2.4.11/13). Ratios are recalculated in your browser from the resolved colours when you move the hue slider; the printed value is the build-time value at hue 195. Disabled controls are exempt from the contrast rule.

Typography IBM Plex Sans (SIL OFL, self-hostable) with a system fallback. IBM Plex Mono for IDs and reference numbers. Tabular numbers everywhere in data.

Fonts: font-family-sans = IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial. Self-host the four WOFF2 files (400, 500, 600, 700) in the extension; the Google Fonts link on this page is for the style guide only. Base size is 14px (0.875rem). Minimum 12px. Never smaller than 11px, only for counters.

Motion, layers, breakpoints Motion explains change; it never decorates. Everything collapses to 1ms under reduced motion.

Durations and easing (hover or tab into a track)

instant 80ms · press feedback
fast 120ms · hover, colour change
base 200ms · toggles, menus (emphasized)
slow 320ms · modal, panel enter (enter)

Easing: standard cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1) · enter (0,0,0,1) · exit (.3,0,1,1) · emphasized (.3,0,0,1.15).

Density SuiteCRM is data-dense. Compact is the default for list and record views on a mouse. Comfortable switches on automatically for touch (pointer: coarse) and gives 44px targets.

32px meets WCAG 2.2 target size minimum (2.5.8, 24px). Touch devices get 44px. Use the density selector at the top of this page to compare.

Yes/No flags use the segmented radio (both options visible, 1 click). The toggle is only for settings that apply immediately. Required marker is the asterisk plus aria-required; errors say what to fix, never colour alone (icon + text + 2px border).

Detail and edit use the same panel + grid. Detail shows .tkc-value text, edit shows the input in the same cell, so nothing jumps. Grid is auto-fill with 15rem minimum columns: 1 column on phone, 2-3 on laptop, 4 on wide. span-all is for subject and long text. Sidebar (sidebarWidgets) stacks under the content below 1024px.

Every pill has a text label and a dot; colour is never the only signal. Same colour = same meaning across entities: blue open/active, amber waiting/attention, violet in progress/updated, green done/won, red urgent/lost, grey neutral/closed.

Entries differ by label, icon, border and background, not by colour alone: customer = blue, left accent; agent = brand teal; internal note = amber with dashed border, lock icon and the words "Not visible to the customer". Newest first by default (toggle in header). Composer border turns dashed amber when Internal note is selected, so a note cannot be mistaken for a reply.
